svg.aria-label: Strobe Rust shader visualizer engine architecture infographic showing content inputs, app thread, rendering pipeline and frame lifecycle
svg.text: How authored scenes and live signals become synchronized projector frames.
Cache, warm next, resume + beat timing
One GL owner thread · controls and audio arrive through nonblocking handoffs
Time advances per scene; each active, outgoing or warming session runs independently.
Script uniforms sealed at load · no shader compilation during show playback
Auto uses native first, then ANGLE on Windows if needed.
Specialized GLSL program per pass · sampler units and FBOs bound at load
Live + outgoing frames → transition mix → master / color / mirror
Post pass is skipped entirely when meta controls are neutral.
ORDER OF OPERATIONS / READ LEFT → RIGHT
DESIGNED FOR LOW-END GPUs AND LIVE OPERATION
auto may fall back to ANGLE.
